svg.title: A four by four grid of states with transitions pointing right and up and a hatched middle square; edges are labelled u, a along the left side, e, f, g along the bottom, h, i, d along the right side, v, w, x, b, c, y, z inside; the path gamma_2 (up the left side and along the row above the hatched square) is highlighted in blue and gamma_4 (along the bottom and up the right side) in red.
